prompt:
A finished painted background for a 2D narrative adventure game: a single digital painting with visible, confident brushwork in the manner of traditional gouache and oil sketching, painterly edges, simplified shapes, rich atmospheric perspective and a limited dusk palette of deep blue, violet and teal with warm orange accents only at the horizon, in the lit window and in the lamps. The picture is designed for a slow camera move in depth, so it is built from clearly separated depth planes with clean, readable silhouettes: every object stands out from what lies behind it by a clear change of value and colour (no ink outlines), and there is no fog, mist or haze blurring the edges between near and far objects. Eye-level view from the quay, as if standing on it: the camera is about two metres above the paving and looks straight out to sea, the horizon is a straight level line at 40 % of the picture height from the top. Composition from near to far: the nearest things are two barrels, a stack of crates and a coil of rope standing on the quay at the lower right, a few metres from the viewer, clearly in front of the sea; the open paving of the quay fills the lower middle of the picture and stays completely free (game characters walk there later); the iron lantern on its wooden post stands on the quay at about 40 % of the picture width in the middle ground; the harbour-master's cottage stands on the quay in the left third, its front facing the viewer, a little behind the walking area; the wooden jetty reaches out into the water in the centre with the two boats moored beside it; farther away on the right a rocky headland with the lighthouse at about 80 % of the picture width; behind everything the calm open sea, distant islands at the horizon and the sky. Keep every object at least 6 % away from the picture edges: the frame will be cropped and moved. Effects that the game animates are not painted: the lighthouse lamp only as a small glowing spot without any beam, rays or halo, no smoke from the chimney, no birds, no lens flare, the lantern glass glows with only a very small soft glow around it. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a postcard, not a cartoon with ink outlines, no heavy fog.
Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.

Turn the reference painting into its depth map. Output a grayscale depth map of exactly the same picture: identical composition, framing, perspective, object positions and object outlines, aligned pixel for pixel with the reference painting, same image size. Encoding: brightness means nearness. The nearest things (the quay paving at the bottom edge and the barrels, crates and rope at the lower right) are white or very light grey; everything gets gradually darker with distance; the horizon line and the distant islands are nearly black; the whole sky including clouds and stars is pure black. Surfaces that recede from the viewer (the quay paving, the sea surface, the jetty planks) are smooth continuous gradients that get darker toward the horizon. Every standing object (cottage, chimney, lantern and its post, barrels, crates, rope coil, boats, masts, jetty posts, headland, lighthouse) is a solid shape with a smooth tone that matches its distance, a little lighter on parts that reach toward the viewer, with crisp sharp edges exactly along the silhouette of the object in the painting, and a clear step in brightness wherever a nearer object overlaps something farther away. Thin things like the masts, ropes and the lantern post keep their exact position and width. No colours, no texture, no brush strokes, no lighting, no shadows, no glow, no outlines, no text: a clean, noise-free depth image like the output of a depth-estimation network. Image format: landscape 3:2.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Repaint the character of the first reference image in exactly the same pose, size and position on the canvas: a stout badger courier walking to the right, seen from the side, mid-stride with the near leg straight under the body and the far leg lifted behind. Keep the silhouette, the pose of the legs and arms, the parcel under the arm, the satchel, the scarf ends, the cap and every costume detail where they are. Change only the painting technique: paint it in the technique of the second reference image (a painted harbour at dusk for a narrative adventure game): visible confident brushwork like gouache and oil sketching, simplified shapes, a few clear value steps, painterly edges, only a little fine fur detail. No dark ink outlines around the figure or inside it: shapes are separated by changes of value and colour like the painted objects in the second reference image. No cel shading, no 3D render look, no plastic shading, no comic look. The outer silhouette stays clear, simple and readable. Light: soft, even, slightly cool dusk light from above, mid values; no strong light from one side and no rim light (the game adds the lights). The dark green cap and vest stay clearly green, the scarf red, the cream shirt light, the black-and-white face stripes and the eye readable. The third reference image is only a check for the costume and its colours: do not copy its layout, its several views or its drawing style. The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm. One single figure, isolated on a fully transparent background, no ground, no shadow.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: square 1:1.

Edit the reference painting into its clean background plate for a 2.5D camera move. Output exactly the same painting with the same size, framing, perspective, horizon line, colours, light and brushwork, aligned pixel for pixel with the reference, but with these objects removed: the harbour-master's cottage with its chimney, plants and lamp, the lantern on its wooden post, the wooden jetty with all its posts and ropes, the two boats with their masts and rigging, the barrels, the crates, the coil of rope and the bollard. Where an object is removed, paint what would be seen behind it, continuing the surroundings seamlessly in the same painterly technique: the sky and clouds continue behind the cottage and the lantern, the calm sea with its horizontal ripples and reflections continues where the boats and the jetty were, and the stone paving of the quay with its edge along the water continues where the barrels, crates and the cottage stood. Keep the warm reflections of the evening light on the wet paving and on the water where they are. Keep unchanged: the sky, the stars, the distant islands, the sea, the rocky headland with the white lighthouse with the red band and its small house, the open quay paving. Do not add anything new, no people, no animals, no birds, no boats.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.
